nodes.author: angie_paperclip
nodes.text:
@rkalyes1 @MinofHealthUG @ChefKarim02 @ACCESS_UG @UScientists @DrKisaBrian I had this thing between 18th and 31st. 
Started as normal flu, irritating throat on day 1, dry cough on day 2 with fevers, day 3 I had deep yellow mucus and sputum with blood streaks, I ignored and was taking some flu meds then got okay in like 2 days. It was dry again. On 24th

nodes.author: angie_paperclip
nodes.text:
@rkalyes1 @MinofHealthUG @ChefKarim02 @ACCESS_UG @UScientists @DrKisaBrian My mucus clear, no more symptoms. 

The doctor said if I had taken 2-3 more days the outcome would have been worse.

Mask up, wash hands, keep hands off your face, avoid crowds if possible and distance
✌️

nodes.author: angie_paperclip
nodes.text: @rkalyes1 @MinofHealthUG @ChefKarim02 @ACCESS_UG @UScientists @DrKisaBrian down. Felt like there was a fire in my upper lungs. Went to  nearby Lifelink, did CXR, sputum analysis... was diagnosed with pneumonia but hadn't reached lung bases. Was nebulised ( had to buy own machine due to the frequency of the times), given IVs for 5 days and I'm on orals.

nodes.author: angie_paperclip
nodes.text: @rkalyes1 @MinofHealthUG @ChefKarim02 @ACCESS_UG @UScientists @DrKisaBrian it got productive again and i was like having a nasal hemorrhage,  yellow green mucus, the chest pain !!!!! Sinus Headaches, fevers, joint aches but didn't really act, 25th I was down but the dyspnoea made me worse. Could only breathe well when seated or standing but not lying
